description: Give one person view access after they sign in with this address, and email them the link; an address that already has a share comes back with created false. View-only. A person with an account sees the dashboard at once; anyone else has the share attached the moment they sign up or sign in with that address. The same address again returns the existing share with created false and sends nothing. The dashboard need not be public: this is how named people see a private one. Needs an API key: with none yet, call signup first.

email.description: The person who may view the dashboard after signing in with this address. They get an email with the link.

name: share_dashboard
title: Share dashboard
